csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode.Components; public class AttachAnimator { public static string Run() { Unity.Netcode.NetworkManager nm = Object.FindObjectOfType<Unity.Netcode.NetworkManager>(true); if (nm == null || nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab == null) return "No PlayerPrefab"; GameObject prefab = nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab; ClientNetworkAnimator cna = prefab.GetComponent<ClientNetworkAnimator>(); if (cna == null) { cna = prefab.AddComponent<ClientNetworkAnimator>(); } Animator anim = prefab.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>(); if (anim != null) { cna.Animator = anim; UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(prefab); UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.SaveAssets(); return "Added ClientNetworkAnimator and linked Animator!"; } return "Added ClientNetworkAnimator but no Animator found in children!"; } }
